pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 CLAUSES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Clauses
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Clauses, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to use a variety of sentences in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise the noun clause that begin with that and what from a given context,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Clauses in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use noun clauses in varied contexts,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Clauses in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. acknowledge the importance of the noun clause in communication. ● in pairs, learners are guided to read a given text on popular sports, ● in groups, learners are guided to work with others to identify noun clauses that begin with that and what, ● in groups, learners are guided to write sentences using the given clause types and put them on a chart, ● in groups, learners are guided to scan the chart and upload it on youtube, ● in groups, learners are guided to write a theme-based skit featuring noun clauses and dramatise it to the whole class. Why is it important to use a variety of sentences in communication? 88

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Clauses in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use noun clauses in varied contexts,

C. acknowledge the importance of the noun clause in communication. ● in pairs, learners are guided to read a given text on popular sports, ● in groups, learners are guided to work with others to identify noun clauses that begin with that and what, ● in groups, learners are guided to write sentences using the given clause types and put them on a chart, ● in groups, learners are guided to scan the chart and upload it on youtube, ● in groups, learners are guided to write a theme-based skit featuring noun clauses and dramatise it to the whole class. Why is it important to use a variety of sentences in communication? 88

   Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Clauses helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Clauses together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner cultivates independent learning when they write a theme-based skit featuring noun clauses and

dramatise it to the whole class.

Values:
Integrity: The learner inculcates discipline while writing sentences using the given clause types and putting them on a chart.

Pertinent contemporary issues (PCIs)

Life skills in education: The learner learns to negotiate for their opinion to be accepted when working with others to identify

noun clauses that begin with that and what.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Print texts

● Braille texts

● Electronic reading materials

● Digital devices with assistive technology

● Audio visual clips

Suggested Skills:

● Recognising the noun clause that begins with that and what from a given context.

● Using noun clauses in varied contexts.
